hypothesis: A targeted improvement to the frozen v8 pooled-year-centroid OrbitTrace framework can reduce its known failure mode of fragmented sparse-support recovery by introducing a constrained, non-learned support-aggregation refinement without reopening rejected recurrence or detector architectures.

allowed: existing non-blind development partitions already authorized by repository rules

blind_data: all frozen blind validation datasets and untouched external confirmations

success_criteria.primary: Beat the frozen v8 baseline under the repository benchmark protocol without using blind data for development.
secondary: show improvement on required transfer benchmarks
success_criteria.failure: Any result failing the frozen benchmark is recorded as FAIL or NO-GO without rescue tuning.

baselines: required literature baselines specified by repository benchmark rules
existing tuned HDBSCAN references where applicable
transfer_benchmarks: Use only predeclared transfer benchmarks from repository rules; do not add benchmarks after seeing results.
experiment_family_bound: One bounded method family: constrained support-aggregation refinement around v8 topology. No architecture search, no parameter rescue sweep.
forbidden_behavior: No changing success criteria after observing results
No revival of frozen NO-GO methods
No hidden hyperparameter sweeps to rescue failure
No creation of a new detector/ranker/membership universe
